name: Enchanter's Workshop
description: The guild's sole venue for item mutation. One enchant slot per item, handcrafted scripts only. The Workshop bends things, it does not mass-produce them.

tiers.description: Stat-line enchants: keener edges, harder plate, deeper wells.
Scripted enchants: wards, waymarks, mending verses. Living effects written onto worn things.

A doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Unbinding Floor: Cleanse blighted items, and a cleansed item keeps twice what the corruption gave it. Or the Attunement Forge: rebind a staff's opening card to any card in your deck.

doctrines.name: The Unbinding Floor
doctrines.description: Cleanse a blighted item: the drawback lifts, the slot unseals, and the item keeps twice the strength its blight gave it. Blighted spoils become worth hunting.

doctrines.name: The Attunement Forge
doctrines.description: Rebind a staff: its Innate opening card becomes any card in your deck. The staff becomes the first move of every fight.
